scenario.note: Limit on overmanning at semi-skilled level to 9 workers total across years; other parameters adjusted as per scenario.

The overmanned limit for semi-skilled workers is set to 9 across all years. The original requirement change for year 1 unskilled is preserved, and new requirements are added for year 3 skilled and year 2 unskilled.
The minimum number of workers downgraded in year 1 is reduced from 210 to 170.

Short-time worker productivity is reduced from 50% to 40%, meaning each short-time worker contributes only 40% of a full-time worker's output, thus increasing the required workforce to cover the shortfall.
A 25% reduction in short-time worker productivity is modeled as a parameter change to short_time_productivity.
Cap on total recruitment at skilled level, and changes to requirements, retraining, and parameters as specified.
